scenes.headline: Streaming 3D from video, memory held flat
scenes.sub: Two systems build on a frozen Depth-Anything-3 backbone
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Calloway! Two systems rebuild the world from a moving camera, one frame at a time.

scenes.text: Both freeze Depth-Anything-3 and stop storing one dense pointmap per frame. They keep a small, bounded summary instead.
scenes.say: Both freeze the same depth model, and stop storing a dense point map per frame. They keep a small bounded summary instead.

scenes.title: The streaming pipeline, shared by both

steps.say: Each video frame enters a frozen geometry model that already knows depth and shape.
It turns the frame into one small token, a compact summary of the view.
A tiny head compares tokens in pairs and predicts camera motion, scoring how much to trust each one.
The trusted links fold into one running estimate, keeping only a fixed set of key frames. Memory stops growing.

scenes.title: Why regress motion, not absolute pose

left.title: Anchor to frame one
items: Every pose lives in one global frame
Travel far and the numbers grow unbounded
left.say: The old way pins everything to frame one. Travel far, and the numbers grow without bound, so the track drifts.

right.title: Relative edges with confidence
items: Predict motion between pairs of frames
Any frame can anchor the next
right.say: The first system predicts only motion between pairs, weighted by confidence, so any frame can anchor the next.

scenes.title: The SLAM backend, no bundle solve

steps.say: The second system tracks each frame fast against a tiny local memory.
Chunks of the map are stitched by near links, longer links, and loop links when a place returns.
It all becomes one pose graph, with no slow bundle solve, so moving cars no longer break it.

scenes.title: Streaming trajectory error, Sintel
scenes.note: lower is better; R-cubed is the smallest model here
scenes.say: On streaming benchmarks the first system has the lowest trajectory error, and it is the smallest model.

scenes.label: Highway drive error, camera then with LiDAR
scenes.say: Add LiDAR on a brutal highway drive, and the error falls from fifty six metres to under three.

scenes.text: The geometry model is now a frozen part. The real work is keeping memory flat and skipping the slow solve.
scenes.say: The geometry model is now a frozen part. The real work is holding memory flat and skipping the slow solve.

recap: Freeze the depth model, reuse it
Keep a bounded summary, not a map per frame
Weight links by confidence, skip the solve
scenes.say: Freeze the depth model, keep a bounded summary, trust each link, and stream geometry from endless video.
